messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Tell your doctor if you have anything that raises your risk of a heart rhythm problem called QT prolongation.
QT prolongation includes:
congenital long QT syndrome, a heart rhythm condition you are born with
a family history of long QT syndrome
a recent heart attack
heart failure that is not well controlled
a slow or irregular heartbeat (bradyarrhythmia)
other conditions that make heart rhythm problems more likely
Hydroxyzine should not be given to women who are breastfeeding.
It is not known whether hydroxyzine passes into breast milk.
Many medicines do.
The oral solution contains a small amount of alcohol, 0.5% by volume.
It is sweetened with sucrose.
Tell your doctor if either of these matters for you.
Triplet: ["Hydroxyzine", "has unknown effect on", "breast milk"]

The relation 'has unknown effect on' in the triplet is defined as 'The effect of the subject drug on the entity specified by the object entity is not known.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has no interaction with': The subject drug does not have a known pharmacological interaction with the object entity.
B. 'does not show up on': The subject drug is not typically detected by the type of test specified by the object entity.
C. 'mechanism of action in': The subject drug's mechanism of action in the specified condition or disease is not known.
D. 'does not act on': The subject drug does not exert its effects directly on the anatomical or physiological entity specified by the object entity.
E. 'has effect': The subject drug produces the effect specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
